conventions.usdPerAgentWallDay: observedUsd * 86_400_000 / enabledWallMs (sustained enabled-time projection; NOT a measured 24h bill)
conventions.perCallMicros: ceil(promptTokens * promptPerMTok); output free (completionPerMTok=0); summed across calls
conventions.enabledWallMs: sum of (endMs-startMs) over mode=enabled segments; setup/excluded wall time not counted

tariff.source: https://docs.typesafe.ai/models rate card ($0.042/Mtok input, output free)

phase36Baseline.basis: provider usage at recorded tariff; sustained enabled-time projection, NOT a measured 24h bill

waterSurvivalObserved.note: Zero-paid deterministic-local-survival backend: 0 provider calls, 0 tokens, 0 micros. The literal measured projection is $0/agent/wall-day; the local price snapshot carries promptPerMTok=0.

refreshedPaidEquivalentProjection.method: Apply the recorded Phase 3.6 tariff ($0.042/Mtok input, output free) and per-attempt usage to the water run's OBSERVED attempt cadence. The water run made no paid calls; this is an extrapolation, not a water-survival bill.
assumptions: Per-attempt prompt token usage equals the Phase 3.6 paid mean (7,566.67 tokens). The water-survival observation adds thirst/inWater/drowning/drink fields absent from Phase 3.6, so real paid prompts may be LARGER; this projection is therefore not an upper bound.
Attempt cadence (6 attempts over a ~24-vale-hour enabled window) is taken from the zero-paid water run; a paid backend could change timing/answers and thus cadence.
Tariff held at the recorded typesafe-jev jev-1.14.0 rate card ($0.042/Mtok input, output free, captured 2026-11-21); no volume discounts; account-specific billing not reconciled.
Enabled-time projection convention identical to Phase 3.6 (observed spend x 86,400,000 / enabled ms); a sustained-rate projection, NOT a measured 24-hour bill or invoice.
The ~2x ratio vs Phase 3.6 reflects the water-survival policy issuing ~2x the reflex attempts per vale-day (6 vs 3), not a tariff change.
